name: tech-tools
description: The atlas marketplace: a multi-agent coding architect (atlas) with 39 plainly named skills, 14 core agents, self-improvement hooks, and the atlas-orchestrate methodology (evidence before any done claim), plus an optional organizational deployment plugin (armada) with 4 invocable setup skills, 11 department agents, and 156 department skills, and a book-derived principles checker (programmer) with 20 detected rules, 2 skills and 1 judge agent.

plugins.name: atlas
plugins.description: Multi-agent coding architect: 39 plainly named skills (core orchestration/audit/self-improvement, 14 original task skills, and the Compound Engineering loop ported onto atlas's own control plane - brainstorm/plan/simplify/review/compound/autopilot, plus strategy/pulse/sweep, bakeoff/pov/explain/prototype/optimize/feedback-analysis, git workflow, and frontend/testing (atlas-testing, atlas-test-xcode)/collaboration skills), 14 core agents, Compound Packs (org/team prescriptive-rule roots cited as evidence), hooks including the fallow agent commit/push gate, inline docs-drift warning, todo-board mirror, stale-connector-credential detection, self-improvement (session ingest, chronicle facet capture, memory capture, nudge) and atlas_doctor (session-health check), and the atlas-orchestrate method: deterministic contract tests as the verification step, with runtime evidence before any done claim, plus a durable per-project todo board.

plugins.name: armada
plugins.description: Organizational deployment layer split out of atlas. Four invocable setup skills in run order: armada (deployment status and router), armada-brand (org name, voice, colors, commit style - run first), armada-department (activate one of 11 departments and its agent), armada-connect (the 13 vendor MCP connectors armada ships). Behind them: 11 department agents (data, design, engineering, finance, HR, IT ops, M365, product, productivity, security, support) and 156 department skills carrying org branding, policies, and compliance context. Install alongside atlas only for org use.

plugins.name: programmer
plugins.description: Finds code that breaks book-derived principles. A deterministic Python scanner with 20 detected rules (DRY, small functions, crash early, Law of Demeter, shared state, injection, dependency rule, inheritance tax, CQS and more), each tied to a book and tip and proven by fixtures; JSON and SARIF output for CI. A cited model judge covers what code cannot decide. 2 skills (review, principles) and 1 agent (principles-judge).
